text:
maria_engineering: Quick q — trying to use up remaining PTO in Dec but looks like I'll hit year-end. Can I carry over more than 40 hours into next year? Also, leadership asked to avoid time off during the product launch week — is that an official blackout? Any exceptions for sick/medical?

alex_peopleops: Short answer: carryover allowed up to 80 hours with manager approval; accrual cap is 240 hours. Blackout weeks can be team-level asks or company-designated. If it's a company-level blackout you need manager + people-ops sign-off. Sick/medical always allowed as an exception.

hr-bot: POLICY SNIPPET:
```
PTO Carryover: Up to 80 hours may be carried into the next calendar year with manager approval.
Accrual cap: 240 hours; accrual pauses while balance >= cap.
Blackout Dates: Company-designated blackout weeks require manager approval for PTO; emergencies and documented medical leave are exempt.
```

jamal_product: Is the upcoming Dec 15-17 window a company-designated blackout or just a product ask? Need to know for hiring interview scheduling.

devon_engineering: Also — if I have surgery scheduled early Jan and need to move days from Dec, will that be covered under the carryover/exception rule?

sophie_peopleops: @jamal_product Product asked teams to minimize absences but leadership hasn’t declared a company-wide blackout yet. We’ll confirm by EOD. @devon_engineering yes — documented medical needs are handled as exceptions. Submit the time-off request and attach a note or reach out to people-ops@redwood.ai and we’ll flag it for expedited approval.

maria_engineering: Thanks — one more: what's the manager approval workflow? Submit in Workday and tag manager, or do I need to email too?

alex_peopleops: Put the request in Workday, check the "carryover" box if applicable, and add a short note + tag your manager. For blackout overrides or medical exceptions, add people-ops@redwood.ai to the request or email us directly so we can expedite.

devon_engineering: :thumbsup: will do. Appreciate the clarity.

sophie_peopleops: We’ll post an update in #people-ops and ping managers if any company-level blackout is declared. If you have urgent edge cases DM me and we’ll handle individually.

maria_engineering: Awesome — thanks everyone!
